assessmentType: Subjective visual assessment of the latest user-authorized composition and portfolio-inspired art direction; not an objective pixel-match score.

rubric.notes: All five original portraits are distinct and cohesive: spring waterfall, ornate amber manor, cyan surreal submerged garden, sculpted basalt coast and floating monument. Atmospheric scale, layered depth and rendered realism respond well to the studied portfolio. Compositions are original rather than reproductions.

New, Resume, Load Game, Browse and Host occupy the reference row: left edges 139, 340, 541, 742, 943; top 211; width 197; height 298; gap 4; total width 1001, approximately 1002 including edge rounding. Resume is selected initially.

Heading hierarchy and control positions remain close to the references. Unified dark edge scrims and text shadows improve readability, especially Resume's description over the golden floor. Supporting copy remains deliberately very small at this viewport.
Creature remains behind all five cards as explicitly requested, with crown, eye, hair, outer arm and lower robe visible. Temporary 2D creature artwork is still used pending the actual GLB.

Warm gold background and teal aura retain the first reference's atmosphere, while the five environmental color stories remain distinct. Dense image detail and some bright interior highlights create modest variation in visual weight.
Teal cores, soft halos, restrained gold dust and feather wisps maintain the magical atmosphere without preventing menu interaction. Exact placement varies with animation.

iterationHistory.findings: Correct expanded five-card row and cohesive original portfolio-inspired artwork. Resume description and cyan Load Game heading needed stronger local contrast.
Unified upper and lower edge scrims, stronger footer opacity and text shadows improve readability while preserving the art's rendered detail.

authorizedDifferences: Five cards including Host, as explicitly confirmed by the user.
All five card images use original generated environments inspired by Carla Deveze's portfolio rather than the older reference's game scenes.
Creature remains behind all cards rather than overlapping their faces.
The earlier warm gold background and magical creature atmosphere remain; the later example's blue explanatory banner is omitted.
Desktop and phone landscape composition only; no portrait redesign.
remainingLimits: The actual user-supplied creature GLB has not been received, so its final appearance, materials and animations cannot yet be assessed.
Card artworks are original inspired compositions, not exact reproductions of Carla Deveze's artworks or either screenshot.
Supporting copy is very small at 1280x720, following the reference's scale.
The 9.3 score is a critic's subjective assessment, not a claim of pixel-identical reproduction.
verdict: Meets the requested 9/10 visual target for the current five-card revision. Actual creature GLB integration remains pending.
